# discgolf-course-program-standard

| | |
|---|---|
| Benchmark | Embodied Agent Olympiad |
| Mode | standard (`eai-standard-turn/1.0`) |
| Twin | — (standard only: Olympiad sports have no privileged twin) |
| Simulator / robot | `disc-flight model (Hummel 2003, RK4, dt 0.01 s) with tree, basket and ground contact; MuJoCo scene for the views` / `none` |
| Family / instance | `discgolf_single` |
| Oracle | `full` — solution/: the sport's reference player (camera images and /spec only); tools/check runs it live and it wins the default configuration |
| Agent time budget | 7200 s; tokens: protocol default (PROTOCOL §5) |

## Task
Play a 6-hole disc golf round (par 20) through woods, around two doglegs, over OB water and past a mandatory in a seeded wind; a disc-launcher robot throws, each throw a release (disc, speed, launch angle, nose angle, bank, spin, aim) chosen from the camera images, and the disc flies with a deterministic aerodynamic model (lift, drag and pitching moment of Hummel 2003, gyroscopic precession, spin-down); format `single` (seats A),
action level `low`, program play. Generated by `tools/generate.py` from
`sports/discgolf/sport.toml`; do not edit by hand.

Deviations from the rulebook:

|---|---|---|

## Difficulty
Set at run time: the seed (`RO_SEED`; it draws the match's random conditions).

## Reference solution
`solution/solve.sh` runs the sport's reference player (`solution/builtin_players.py`) through the core's client
(`solution/ro_client.py`): camera images and `/spec` only.

## Verification
The `sim` service (the v0.2 core, `environment/sim/core/`) records the match (`episode.jsonl`) and a fresh process
replays it (state hash); the verifier (`tests/grade.py` = `core/grading.py`, no network) writes the common reward
fields (`success`, `valid_trial`, `deterministic`, `<seat>_won`, ...) and the sport's fields (`tests/sport_grade.py`).

## Details
| | |
|---|---|
| Rules | [PDGA Official Rules of Disc Golf (Professional Disc Golf Association, rev. 2026-01-01)](https://www.pdga.com/rules/official-rules-disc-golf) version 2026-01-01 |
| id | rule | deviation |
| D1 | 802.07 | the thrower is a launcher robot with a stated release scatter; no run-up and no stance rules: the release point is 1.0 m above the lie |
| D2 | 806.02 | out of bounds always uses option 806.02.B (the next lie is the point where the disc was last in bounds), without the 1 m relief |
| D3 | 808 | a hole not holed out after par + 3 throws (penalty throws included) ends there and scores par + 4 (not in the rules; it bounds the round's length) |
| D4 | 805.02 | a disc that rests on a tree drops to the ground below it at once (805.02 does not apply) |
| D5 | 802.03 | no time limit per throw: the player has a chess clock instead; when it runs out the round ends there, and the unfinished hole and the holes not played score par + 4 each |
